name: HAS_ wo yong cui mian APP ba quan xiao nan sheng bian cheng le wo de xing nu !!!
original_name: HAS_我用催眠APP把全校男生变成了我的性奴!!!
source:
This is an R18 RPG game aimed at gay male players, featuring a 36-year-old middle-aged male protagonist who unexpectedly acquires an app that can hypnotize anyone into becoming a sex slave. Using this app, he turns the boys he fancies at school into his sex slaves!
